title: Flow Cytometry Assay and Cell Staining Protocol
author: Miloje Savic
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.jtpcnmn
materials: Flow cytometry assay and cell staining protocol
Miloje Savic and Jennifer L. Dembinski
ConA control (at 5µg/ml final concentration per well)

steps.title: Thaw PBMC
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) according to the “Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells (PBMC) and plasma isolation from whole peripheral blood” thawing procedure.

steps.title: Resuspend Cells in Complete Media
steps.instruction: Resuspend the thawed cells in complete media consisting of RPMI‑1640 supplemented with 10 % heat‑inactivated fetal bovine serum (FBS) and penicillin/streptomycin; adjust the concentration to 2–5 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹ in a 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Overnight Rest Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the cell suspension overnight (~18 h) at 37 °C in a humidified incubator with 5 % CO₂; keep tube caps loose.

steps.title: Wash, Count, Verify Viability
steps.instruction: The next day, wash the cells, resuspend in fresh complete media, and count live cells; ensure viability is ≥ 66 % before proceeding.

steps.title: Prepare Activation Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare activation medium by adding GolgiPlug (Brefeldin A), CD28 antibody, and CD49d antibody to complete media as described in Table 1 so that each reagent is at a final concentration of 5 µg · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Adjust Cell Concentration for Activation
steps.instruction: Dilute the washed cells in the activation medium to obtain 5 × 10⁶ live cells · mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Plate Cells in 96‑Well Plate
steps.instruction: Dispense 200 µL of the cell suspension (1 × 10⁶ live cells) into each well of a U‑bottom 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add Specific Stimuli to Wells
steps.instruction: For each sample add 20 µL of the appropriate stimulus:

substeps.instruction: DMSO blank control (final DMSO concentration matches that of peptide wells).
CD4 peptide library – dilute peptides (originally in 100 % DMSO) in media/DMSO so that the final peptide concentration is 4 µg · mL⁻¹ and DMSO % equals the blank.
CD8 peptide library – same preparation as CD4 library (final 4 µg · mL⁻¹).
Influenza H₂O₂‑inactivated virus – add to achieve 75 HAI units per well.

steps.title: Short Stimulation Incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 4–6 h at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Wash Cells Post‑Stimulation
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with 200 µL cold Flow‑Medium (FM); centrifuge each wash at 350 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: LIVE/DEAD Staining and Bead Prep
steps.instruction: If using a LIVE/DEAD stain, add 0.5 µL of the stain to 100 µL PBS per well and incubate 30 min on ice (4 °C). In parallel, prepare ArC compensation beads:

substeps.instruction: Add one drop of Solution A to each tube of beads together with either 3 µL Aqua (LIVE/DEAD) or 1 µL IR dye per drop.
Wash the beads once with 3 mL FM (or PBS).
Resuspend beads in 500 µL FM and add one drop of Solution B; keep at 4 °C protected from light and do not fix.

steps.title: Fixation and Permeabilization
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL cold Fix/Perm solution to each well, vortex while adding to prevent clumping, and incubate 20 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Wash Cells and Add Compensation Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed cells twice with Perm/Wash (PW) solution:

substeps.instruction: First wash: add 100 µL PW to the Fix/Perm mixture, resuspend, then add 200 µL PW and centrifuge 350 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.
Second wash: repeat the 200 µL PW wash.
In parallel, add 2 drops of negative and 2 drops of positive BD compensation beads to each designated bead well; spin down together with the second PW wash.

steps.title: Optional Brilliant Violet Buffer Addition
steps.instruction: If more than one BD Horizon Brilliant™ Violet antibody is used, add 50 µL Brilliant Stain Buffer per well (add to the 6‑color master mix) and then add 150 µL of the buffer‑containing mixture to each well.

steps.title: Add Fluorophore‑Conjugated Antibodies
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PW containing the appropriate fluorophore‑conjugated antibodies to each well and incubate 30 min at 4 °C in the dark.

steps.title: Post‑Staining Wash and Spin
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL PW to each well and centrifuge 350 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Final Washes and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with Perm/Wash solution (350 × g, 5 min each). Finally, resuspend the cells in 250 µL FM.

steps.title: Prepare Antibody‑Coated Compensation Beads
steps.instruction: For each antibody, create a bead well:

substeps.instruction: Add 2 drops negative and 2 drops positive BD compensation beads.
Add 100 µL PW containing the antibody: mix 5 µL or 20 µL antibody stock with 95 µL or 80 µL PW respectively, according to manufacturer’s recommendation.
Stain the beads using the same steps as for the cells.

steps.title: Store or Acquire Samples for Flow Cytometry
steps.instruction: Either run the samples immediately on a flow cytometer or store them protected from light at 4 °C for up to 72 h (preferably ≤ 24 h) before acquisition.

steps.title: Data Acquisition Requirements
steps.instruction: Acquire at least 40 000 CD4⁺ T cells (or 20 000 CD3⁻CD7⁺ NK cells) per sample for reliable analysis.
